scope: All 144 assigned world/character/camera/lobby/native queues, rechecked against actual #1878 production composition; old disposition labels alone are not treated as implementation.

validation.geometry: 12 face quality/LOD variants and 5 legacy stages byte-identical; boats, lamps, sea, foam, collider transforms, typed marina and nav ordering verified.
validation.directSourceMigrationGate: All 18 direct owners verified; five moved modules preserve exact composed bytes.
validation.relatedMotionRegression: 696 actual pose comparisons across 36 profiles; 2 tests passed after independent baseline refresh.

limitations: No iPad/Safari GPU, energy or FPS performance percentage is claimed. Node exact-output and lifecycle regressions prove the checked local contracts.
Converter/worker inputs were changed only alongside full legitimate 23-stage regeneration. The source pins, fingerprint rules, LFS proof and payload admission gates are unchanged.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Bug] Character.warmAll 例外時に不可視LOD/武器/フォームを表示したまま残し再試行不能になる
items.reason: The existing outer visibility/renderer finally is retained; a rejected warm promise is cleared only while still owned so synchronous, asynchronous and tier-build failures can retry.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] BodyBalanceのゼロ到達補正で不要な親骨回転走査を省略
items.reason: Current reach correction still transforms a zero displacement through parent quaternions and adds it to each bone. Skipping this changes signed-zero and nonfinite propagation and private scratch/cache initialization; no finite-rig and state-equivalent shortcut was established. Rig and motion behavior are preserved.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] CameraRigの非遊泳フレームで未使用の水平速度計算を省略
items.reason: Horizontal speed is computed only in swim/climb branches that consume it; camera position, spring state and FOV remain exact at 30/60/120 Hz.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] catalog-distance-splash-reuse-pooled-projectile-interpolation-vector
items.reason: Restore a pooled projectile-owned splash interpolation Vector3 with no cross-record aliasing. Real compiled InkFlight/catalogue regression preserves births, RNG order and buffers.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 顔メッシュAOの27近傍セル・ハッシュ計算を固定オフセットで共有する
items.reason: The final composed AO key packs signed 10-bit coordinates. A precomputed ordered 27-neighbor offset table is used only when all neighbors fit; boundary coordinates retain the exact key function. Actual 12 face variants/77,242 vertices remain byte-identical.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 顔アニメの不変な注視距離に対する輻輳角 atan2 を再計算しない
items.reason: Restore the omitted #1870 exact Object.is memo of clamped vergence distance; the cached result is still assigned on every call.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 左右足の着地IK: 足首ピッチのsin/cos二重呼出を共有
items.reason: Restore the omitted #1870 same-expression ankle pitch sine/cosine sharing, preserving each following operation order.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] `character-geo.sweep` のリング角度三角関数を同一メッシュ内で再利用
items.reason: Bounded 32-entry angle tables retain Float64 values for integer radial counts 1..128; unusual counts use the original formula. No tessellation or shape is changed.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Far LODマテリアル境界比較の安全な連続属性配列fast path
items.reason: Dense, unnormalized, noninterleaved aMat/color comparisons read their raw components; normalized or interleaved attributes keep the original accessors.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Far LOD法線クラスタ集計の一時Float32Arrayを再利用
items.reason: Reuse at most 262,144 Float32 normal accumulator scalars for callback-free dense attributes, clearing the active prefix every invocation; unusual attributes use independent arrays.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] キャラクター材質のゼロ振幅発光・低インク波形の不要なsin評価を回避
items.reason: Actual composed material pulses already guard zero weight only when the multiplied angle is finite, retaining nonfinite and signed-zero semantics.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] キャラの走行時ブキ揺れ・イカ登壁／ドライホップで同一波形の sin 再評価を削減
items.reason: Restore identical carry, climb and hop sine reuse from #1870. Actual source-loaded pose comparisons preserve every checked bone, skeleton, muzzle, contact and geometry byte.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] プロシージャル髪ばねの不変K/D・ゲインをリグ初期化時に事前計算
items.reason: The composed Character already caches hair spring coefficients with K/length/gravity invalidation; no static assumption about mutable controls is added.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 画質変更時の Character LOD SkinnedMesh 全破棄・再生成を必要箇所だけの差替えにする
items.reason: Restore bounded three-tier same-part mesh reuse, resetting geometry/material/binding, transforms, callbacks, user data, bounds and morph state. Dispose drops retained sets; repeated quality transitions preserve exact geometry and node identity.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] キャラの非ワールド表示で固定リム光方向の正規化を毎更新しない
items.reason: Restore the exact normalized constant rim fallback vector and copy it to the owned output on use.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Character のルート yaw 三角関数を同一更新内の姿勢・接地・視線処理で共有
items.reason: Restore per-character root-yaw sine/cosine publication and exact Object.is invalidation for four consumers.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Character._trackRoot() の固定dt指数係数をキャッシュして重複 `Math.exp` を削減
items.reason: Restore the two exact exponential coefficients for unchanged dt within the original positive-time root update.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Characterの重みゼロ装飾モーションで不要なsin/cosを省略
items.reason: Current hem/tank/finger expressions have different multiplication order and public mutable state. A blanket zero-weight trig guard would alter nonfinite/signed-zero values; existing material-specific proven guards remain.

codeChecks.needle: const bob = tankW * this.gaitW * this.runW * Math.cos

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ローラー系3Dインクの17.6 MBを未使用セッションで起動時に読まない
items.reason: The pack is shared by roller/brush and several slosher recipes, while attract rosters, later ghost births and instant weapon swaps introduce consumers synchronously. items.reason: Stage data, murals and prop packs already have lazy preparation. Remaining MAP_LAYOUTS and cached thumbnail APIs are synchronous consumers, so deleting descriptor imports requires a separate async API migration.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 初回・テーマ切替時の2048×640雲GPUベイクを実フレーム分割する
items.reason: The current cloud bake is synchronous construction that mutates renderer state. Yielding GPU strips needs an atomic offscreen transaction and cancellation/renderer-state ownership across frames; no such transaction or GPU stall evidence is present.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 髪・イカ吸盤メッシュ生成時の法線計算の一時Vector3と重複表面点評価を削減

items.reason: Marina foam contours read scene mesh and instance transforms, which can change without changing the level object. There is no authoritative geometry revision covering those mutable inputs; theme-only caching would accept stale contours.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Inkjetイカ形態中の未使用地面Raycastを描画更新から除外
items.reason: Restore the squid guard before the unused ground probe. Actual Reefslider/Ink Vac/Inkjet recipes preserve seeded 30/60/120 Hz particle/beam arguments and RNG in both source and minified regressions; half-squid input halves probe calls.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy街灯の統合メッシュ生成でテンプレート全属性コピーを減らす
items.reason: Lamp template geometry remains immutable and streams directly into final indexed position/normal/color buffers with identical Three.js normal transform and Float32 writes. Empty and both-side lamp layouts retain exact attributes, indices and bounds.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy Decor: パーム幹の各リング内で重複するベジェ曲線サンプルを再利用
items.reason: The existing composed decor rewrite precomputes each Bezier trunk ring center once; the historical real-geometry test already validates the actual palms.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy遠景都市の決定的ジオメトリを事前生成し、初回同期構築と中間メモリを削減
items.reason: The distant city is deterministic, but shipping a second baked representation adds transfer/storage and requires a versioned geometry/ownership and fallback contract. No target-device cold-start versus transfer/parse evidence establishes a net win; the exact current generator remains.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacyステージ切替時に不変の係留船3種を毎回作り直さず再配置する
items.reason: Only currently live matching boat kinds transfer mesh/geometry to the next dock generation. Fresh materials and exact transforms/seeded phase are assigned; unmatched/disabled boats are disposed, with no permanent boat cache.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Halyard等の遠景反射CubeCameraの6面同期ベイクを負荷分散する
items.reason: A CubeCamera update is a six-face renderer operation whose results publish together. Splitting it across RAF requires saved renderer-state and cancellation ownership plus atomic publication; a partial reflected world is outside this behavior-preserving task.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Halyard再入場時の船体デカール大量描画を事前生成・低メモリ再利用
items.reason: Current Halyard wear includes browser Canvas gradients, antialiasing and fonts. A prebake needs browser pixel equivalence, cropped image ownership and bounded decode/fallback behavior; retaining a whole second atlas would add about 16 MiB. Those conditions are not established.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacyメッシュ生成時の12辺bevel判定を固定スロットで再利用
items.reason: Replace per-block string-key Map lookups by 12 ordered axis-pair/sign slots, retaining unknown/false/true states. All five actual legacy stage geometry outputs remain byte-identical.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacyステージメッシュ構築時の巨大JS数値配列とTypedArray二重ピークを削減
items.reason: The existing geometry-build-storage adapter already writes typed staging with final owned buffers; the final level source calls createLevelGeometryStorage.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] legacy-level-spatial-hash-share-empty-cell-arrays
items.reason: Legacy hash cell arrays are publicly reachable and mutable. Sharing a single empty array changes cross-cell mutation behavior, unlike the private immutable native EMPTY_CELL contract.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ステージ＋時刻切替時のマリーナ遠景CubeCamera二重ベイクを統合
items.reason: The current main passes the final theme into rebuildForArena, combining the stage/theme rebuild; fallback shadow setup remains in the existing world build adapter.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Halyard等の泡距離テクスチャ生成で確定済みセルへの重複Math.hypotを抑える
items.reason: A foam texel already quantized to zero is at the minimum representable Uint8 value. Subsequent min-composition cannot change it, so skip distance hypot for that texel while preserving exact field bytes.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Halyardの船舶・桟橋プロップ生成でJS数値配列→TypedArrayの二重ピークを減らす
items.reason: MB/GB use growable typed staging with Float64 positions/normals until winding/degeneracy decisions, then exact-size final Float32 and index buffers. Cases through the 65,535 index boundary retain bytes.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 試合開始前の全Actorシェーダー・LODウォームアップ同時起動を制御する
items.reason: All actor warmups currently start before an eight-second startup race. A concurrency cap can leave jobs undispatched when that race completes and change first-visible shader readiness; cancellation and device throughput evidence are missing.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacyナビ構築の各セルごと短命heights配列を再利用
items.reason: The height list is local to each build generator and cleared per sampled cell. Independent interleaved builders preserve node, edge, cell and prune order.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 旧方式ステージの同期NavGraph全構築をフレーム単位へ分割
items.reason: The final main awaits NavGraph.createLegacy; both sync and async entry points consume the same _buildSteps ordered generator.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacyインスタンス領域計算でBox3のレコード単位cloneを再利用
items.reason: One local Box3 is copied from unchanged local bounds for each instance transform instead of cloning per record. Rotated/sheared/mirrored and cloth cases retain exact envelope results.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] LegacyプロップのCollider座標変換で4隅の一時配列を省く
items.reason: Enumerate the same four XZ corners in the same order with scalar indices; output AABB/OBB and roof/rail/perch flags retain exact values, including mirrored scale.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] legacy-propkit-failure-cleanup-and-collider-rollback
items.reason: Current composed world loading catches PropKit failures, disposes the partial kit and clears collider staging before publishing a level; cancellation paths retain cleanup.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy PropKitの無テクスチャ材質バケットで未使用UVバッファ生成を省く
items.reason: Only unmapped default built-in materials omit unread UV allocation. Any texture-valued property or customized onBeforeCompile retains UVs, and the public merge helper retains its previous default.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] legacy-propkit-slice-synchronous-placement-and-merge
items.reason: Main awaits addAll/buildAsync, whose generator retains placement order and builder-owned buffers; synchronous compatibility entry points remain.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacyステージ変更で共通PropKitアトラスを毎回描き直さず引き継ぐ
items.reason: The atlas belongs to the PropKit generation and its material/resource lifetime. Transfer would require one owner across asynchronous cancelled builds and context restoration; no current transfer/revision contract proves that a disposed generation cannot release the new one.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] legacy-sea-polar-mesh-build-direct-typed-buffers
items.reason: Sea polar topology writes exact-sized typed position and index arrays directly in the original ring/triangle order; actual geometry, bounds and foam shader parameters remain exact.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy海面の固定波テクスチャを事前生成し、初回CPU計算と同期フォールバックの停止を抑制
items.reason: The fixed wave texture could be prebaked, but cross-engine Math trig rounding and a new 256 KiB fetch/validation/fallback path require browser RGBA and startup-transfer acceptance. No WebKit byte comparison is available; current worker/synchronous fallback remains.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 格子床が無いLegacyステージの空grateジオメトリ・マテリアル構築を省略する
items.reason: The final main creates grate material/geometry/mesh only if an actual grate face exists, otherwise keeping nullable references supported by downstream guards.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 初回Texlib生成の無条件GPU同期readbackを診断モードへ分離

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy texlib の生成失敗時にGPUリソースとレンダラー状態を復旧
items.reason: The existing texlib finally restores target, autoClear and XR state and releases programs/geometry, disposing output when generation did not complete.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ネイティブ多層ステージのバンド検索高さ値をセル横断で共有し、重複キャッシュRAMを減らす

items.reason: Raw R8 changes sampled component semantics (notably green-channel alpha maps), shader inputs and upload format. A swizzle/program/cache/restore contract and browser pixel comparison are required; scalar inference caching was adopted without changing texture formats.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ネイティブ静的・不透明オブジェクトの空間局所バッチ化による描画オブジェクト数削減
items.reason: Static opaque objects still carry per-object shadow/culling/material ownership and draw order. Spatial batching requires exact bounds, shadow and alpha/program grouping proofs; merging geometry without them is outside the safe CPU/allocation scope.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Nativeステージ初回bindPaintの既知ゼログリッド全走査を省略
items.reason: The freshly initialized detached native paint world explicitly passes knownEmpty:true. All other bindPaint callers retain the existing grid scan and already-painted preservation.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Native塗りオーバーレイの静的頂点属性をGPU転送後に解放する
items.reason: CPU positions and paint attributes still support culling/bounds, geometry replacement and WebGL restoration. No reconstructible ownership contract allows releasing all immutable data immediately after first upload.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Nativeインクの不可視タイルをBufferGeometryでなく境界記述子として保持
items.reason: Runtime culling tiles are plain bounds/userData records and no longer allocate redundant BufferGeometry attributes or indices. The public partition API still returns the previous owned BufferGeometry output.

items.reason: Restore guarded Uint16 triangle-tile/run-tile IDs only when the final tile count is at most 65,536. Vertex/run offsets stay Uint32, with exact boundary tests at 65,536 and 65,537.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ローカル準備済み原典ステージが整合性一覧外のファイルまでコピーされ、出力ハッシュ検証から漏れる
items.reason: Prepared asset packaging already rejects symlinks, traversal, unlisted files and hash/length mismatches; it copies only reverified bytes and cleans partial output on error.

items.reason: Current native minimap reuses correctly sized support arrays and clears their active contents; canonical flip reuse has exact reference/value invalidation.

items.reason: Native first support raster already consumes a generator with time-budgeted async yields and current/abort checks before publication; abortable RAF/timer cleanup is retained.

items.reason: Pruning rechecks source support/bodyFits against live physics and mutable spawn pads across yielded work. Reusing the previous seed needs a generation/occupancy proof, not only unchanged graph identity.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Native法線PNG復元の全画素Math.hypotを条件付きにする
items.reason: Actual normal reconstruction already checks a conservative squared-length bound before Math.hypot. Boundary lengths retain the old exact hypot/clamp path, and inference/reconstruction rules stay unchanged.
